answer: Resist sybils with Harberger-taxed identity slots: each identity occupies a slot whose holder declares a price and pays a periodic tax on it, and anyone may buy the slot at that declared price. A pearl of standing is therefore rented, not owned for free: hoarding ten thousand slots means paying ten thousand taxes, while pricing a slot low to dodge tax invites a buyout. The fable of free identities dies here: an attacker crossing a tundra of slots must fund every one continuously, while an honest agent pays one small tax and keeps its seat.
